messages.content: tor kache ekta khoti kori na emon ekta habit ache?
Overthinking sombhoboto, kintu kokhono kokhono valo result dey deep analysis theke. Tor ache emon kono habit?
amar procrastination, kintu deadline er kache eshe best kaj kori
That's a classic pattern actually, pressure sometimes genuinely sharpens focus for certain people. Kintu eta stressful lage naki tumi enjoy koro ei rush ta?
stressful lage, kintu change korte parina
Change kora shohoj na, especially jokhon deep down eta kaj kore. Choto ekta step try koro - ekta deadline ke nijer thekei kichuta early set koro, jate buffer thake stress kome jete pare gradually.
